games.note: P0 casts Exquisite Blood turn 15, then Lightning Bolt targeting P1 (seat-1 candidate answered via the top-level Interaction envelope). Bolt resolves: P1 20->17. Exquisite Blood's TriggeredAbility goes on the stack (source = EB on P0's battlefield); driver holds priority to observe it, then releases. Trigger resolves: P0 20->23. Stack empty, game proceeds.

notes: Life totals are from ExportAuthoritativeState envelopes: pre (20/20, EB on P0 BF, Bolt in P0 hand), mid_trigger (P0 20 / P1 17, one TriggeredAbility on the stack sourced from EB object 22 on P0's battlefield), post (P0 23 / P1 17, stack empty).

P0's life moved 20->23, exactly the 3 life P1 lost: the controller GAINED life per the Oracle text ('Whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much life.'). The reported outcome (controller loses life) does not occur on v0.81.0.
No other life-change sources exist in either deck (lands, Exquisite Blood, Lightning Bolt, Forests only), so the +3 is unambiguously the trigger's resolution.
waiting_for types seen include Priority and TargetSelection; the Bolt's target prompt offered seat 0 and seat 1 candidates and the driver answered seat 1 via choice 9LX3Y2.0.220.t1.
setup_line: P0 (Exquisite Blood + Lightning Bolt) vs P1 (Forests); two human-driver seats
contract_line: When an opponent loses life, Exquisite Blood's controller must gain exactly that much life
